name: HQ-Edit

text_fields.label: Input
text_fields.value: A bustling traditional market scene with vendors and shoppers, vibrant textiles, and hanging lanterns under a sunlit arcade.

text_fields.label: Edit
text_fields.value: Add futuristic elements such as holographic displays and floating platforms while maintaining the market's traditional structure.

text_fields.label: Inverse edit
text_fields.value: Remove futuristic elements and restore traditional market elements like textiles and static lanterns.

text_fields.label: Output
text_fields.value: A market that blends tradition with futuristic technology, featuring holographic displays, floating platforms, and shoppers interacting with advanced systems amidst a traditional architectural setting.

text_fields.label: Input
text_fields.value: A workbench with various tools including a red and black circular saw, a yellow measuring tape, a utility knife, a handsaw, a chisel, a wooden mallet, a coping saw, a try square, and some wooden planks with sawdust scattered around.

text_fields.label: Edit
text_fields.value: replace the wooden mallet with a metal hammer, add a red pencil, remove the chisel, coping saw, and try square, and place a metal mug next to the circular saw.

text_fields.label: Inverse edit
text_fields.value: replace the metal hammer with a wooden mallet, remove the red pencil, add back the chisel, coping saw, and try square, and remove the metal mug.

text_fields.label: Output
text_fields.value: A workbench with various tools including a red and black circular saw, a yellow measuring tape, a utility knife, a handsaw, a metal hammer, a red pencil, and some wooden planks with sawdust scattered around, and a metal mug next to the circular saw.

text_fields.label: Input
text_fields.value: A rusty hammer with a worn wooden handle lies on a dirty barn floor covered in hay, dirt, and debris. The barn has wooden walls with gaps allowing beams of light to enter, and cobwebs are visible in the upper corner.

text_fields.label: Edit
text_fields.value: Remove the rust from the hammer, polish the metal to a shine, and replace the worn handle with a new wooden one. Clean the barn floor, removing all dirt and debris, and lay down fresh, clean hay.

text_fields.label: Inverse edit
text_fields.value: Reapply rust to the hammer, scuff the metal, and replace the new handle with an old, worn one. Scatter dirt, debris, and old hay on the barn floor, making it look dirty and used again.

text_fields.label: Output
text_fields.value: A shiny, restored hammer with a new wooden handle rests on a clean barn floor covered in fresh, clean hay. The barn's wooden walls still have gaps with beams of light shining through, and cobwebs remain in the upper corner.

text_fields.label: Input
text_fields.value: A person is performing a trick on a skateboard at a skatepark with various ramps and graffiti-covered walls.

text_fields.label: Edit
text_fields.value: Replace the skateboard with a BMX bike and add multiple BMX riders performing tricks in the background.

text_fields.label: Inverse edit
text_fields.value: Replace the BMX bike with a skateboard and remove the additional BMX riders in the background.

text_fields.label: Output
text_fields.value: A person is performing a trick on a BMX bike at a skatepark with various ramps and graffiti-covered walls, with multiple BMX riders performing tricks in the background.

text_fields.label: Input
text_fields.value: A black Labrador puppy with bright eyes and a shiny coat is lying on the grass, holding a black and white soccer ball with its front paws. The puppy is looking directly at the camera with a playful expression. In the background, there is a wooden fence and a garden with blooming sunflowers and various colorful flowers.

text_fields.label: Edit
text_fields.value: Replace the soccer ball with a giant sunflower that the puppy is holding in the same manner as the soccer ball.

text_fields.label: Inverse edit
text_fields.value: Replace the giant sunflower with the original soccer ball, ensuring the puppy holds it in the same way as before.

text_fields.label: Output
text_fields.value: A black Labrador puppy with bright eyes and a shiny coat is lying on the grass, holding a giant sunflower with its front paws. The puppy is looking directly at the camera with a playful expression and its tongue sticking out slightly. In the background, there is a wooden fence and a garden with blooming sunflowers and various colorful flowers.

text_fields.label: Input
text_fields.value: a silver teapot with a reflection of a bright kitchen window is placed on a wooden table.

text_fields.label: Edit
text_fields.value: change the reflection on the teapot to show a clear blue sky with clouds instead of the bright kitchen window

text_fields.label: Inverse edit
text_fields.value: change the reflection on the teapot back to show the bright kitchen window instead of the clear blue sky with clouds

text_fields.label: Output
text_fields.value: a silver teapot with a reflection of a clear blue sky with clouds is placed on a wooden table.
